players.bio: Alan James Forrest (born 9 September 1996) is a Scottish footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee, Born in Prestwick, he began his career with Ayr United, coming through their academy and making 245 appearances for the Honest Men.

Ashley Stephen Thomas Hay (born 10 July 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. Hay is a product of the Luton Town academy and began his senior career in non-League football in 2020. He transferred to Brentford B in 2023 and played his first professional senior football on loan at Cheltenham Town.
Bobby Wales (born 23 June 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Bradley Halliday (born 10 July 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for EFL League One club Bradford City. He previously played for Cambridge United and Middlesbrough, and had loan spells with York City, Hartlepool United and Accrington Stanley.
Bradley Thomas Fink (born 17 April 2003) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a striker for Wycombe Wanderers.
Callum Graham Jones (born 5 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. Born in England, he represents Wales internationally.

Charley Oosenbrugh (born 23 June 2009) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish League One club Montrose, on a co-operation loan from Scottish Premiership club Dundee. Club career Youth career Oosenbrugh joined the youth academy of Dundee at the age of six, and has been part of the club's Performance School at St John's RC High School.

Charlie Reilly (born 5 December 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a winger or midfielder for Dundee. He has previously played for Hamilton Academical, Partick Thistle and Albion Rovers, as well as having been on loan with Airdrieonians, Arbroath and Inverness Caledonian Thistle.

rey Jermaine Wright (born 30 April 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back, right wing-back or right winger. He currently plays for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. The son of former Ipswich Town and Southampton midfielder Jermaine Wright, Wright progressed through the Academy at Colchester United before he made his first-team debut in 2012.
Ethan Billy Hamilton (born 18 October 1998) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Finlay Robertson (born 12 November 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Harrison Sharp (born 4 April 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Idris Adewale Olarewaju Odutayo (born 26 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Imari Narain Che Hines-Samuels (born 5 February 2003) is an English footballer who plays for Scottish Premiership club Dundee as a left-back.
Jack Lee Moorhouse (born 29 November 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Leyton Orient on loan from Manchester United.
Joseph Brooks Bevan (born 15 July 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Joseph Anthony Westley (born 18 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays for Scottish Premiership club Dundee, as a striker.

Kieran Michael O'Hara (born 22 April 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. Born in England, he plays for the Republic of Ireland national team at international level. O'Hara qualifies to play for the Republic of Ireland through his paternal grandparents, who are from Galway.

Matai Eyitayo Akinmboni is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee, on loan from Premier League club Bournemouth. Akinmboni is a central defender who plays for D.C. United's USL affiliate Loudoun United while training at the D.C. United Academy.
Owen Lucas Bevan (born 26 October 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. He is a former Wales under-21 international.

Owen Olamidayo Goodman (born 27 November 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Dundee, on loan from Premier League club Crystal Palace. Born in England, Goodman has played for both England and Canada at youth level and has been called up by but never featured for the Canada national team.

Ryan Astley (born 4 October 2001) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. Early life Astley is from Llanfair Caereinion. Club career Astley began his career with Everton, making his debut for their under-23 team at the age of 16 in 2018, before being offered a new contract in April 2021.
Ryan James Finnigan (born 22 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.

Simon Murray (born 22 March 1992) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club Dundee. After beginning his senior career with Montrose, Murray played for several junior clubs before returning to senior football with Arbroath in 2014. He signed for Dundee United in January 2015, but initially remained with Arbroath on loan.

Steven John Pressley (born 11 October 1973) is a Scottish professional football manager and former player who played as a centre back. He is currently the head coach of Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
Žan Bešir is a Slovenian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee.
